sn22.96:1.2: nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 4
sn22.96:1.3: Atthi nu kho bhante kiñci rūpaṃ yaṃ rūpam niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassatam avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati || 5
sn22.96:1.4: Atthi nu kho bhante kāci vedanā yā vedanā niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati || || 6
sn22.96:1.5: Atthi nu kho bhante kāci saññā yā saññā || pe || || 7
sn22.96:1.6: Atthi nu kho bhante keci saṅkhārā ye saṅkārā niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassanti || || 8
sn22.96:1.7: Atthi nu kho bhante kiñci viññāṇaṃ yaṃ viññāṇaṃ niccam dhuvaṃ sassatam avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tattheva ṭhassatīti || || 9
sn22.96:1.8: Natthi kho bhikkhu kiñci rūpaṃ yam rūpaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassatam avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati || || 10-13
sn22.96:1.12: kiñci viññāṇaṃ yaṃ viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassatam avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassatīti || || 14
sn22.96:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā parittaṃ gomayapiṇḍaṃ pāṇinā gahetvā tam bhikkhum etad avoca || || 15
sn22.96:2.2: Ettako pi kho bhikkhu attabhāvapaṭilābho natthi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati || || 16
sn22.96:2.3: Ettako ce pi bhikkhu attabhāvapaṭilābho abhavissa nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo || na yidam brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammādukkhakkhayāya || ||
sn22.96:2.4: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhu ettako pi attabhāvapaṭilābho natthi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo || tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammādukkhakkhayāya || || 17
sn22.96:3.1: Bhūtapubbāham bhikkhu rājā ahosiṃ khattiyo muddhāvasitto ||
sn22.96:3.2: tassa mayham bhikkhu rañño sato khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa catūrāsīti nagarasahassāni ahesuṃ Kusāvatīnāma-rājadhānipamukhāni || || 18
sn22.96:3.3: Tassa mayham bhikkhu rañño sato khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa caturāsīti pāsādasahassāni ahesuṃ Dhammapāsādapamukhāni || || 19
sn22.96:3.4: Tassa mayham bhikkhu rañño sato khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa caturāsīti kūṭāgārasahassāni ahesuṃ Mahābyūhakuṭāgārapamukhāni || || 20
sn22.96:3.5: Tassa mayham bhikkhu rañño sato khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa caturāsīti pallaṅkasahassāni ahesuṃ || dantamayāni sāramayāni sovaṇṇamayāni rūpiyamayāni goṇakatthatāni paṭikatthatānipaṭalikatthatāni kadalimiga pavarapaccattharaṇāni sa-uttaracchadanāni ubhato lohitakūpadhānāni || || 21
sn22.96:3.6: Tassa mayham bhikkhu rañño sato khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa caturāsīti nāgasahassāni ahesuṃ || sovaṇṇālaṅkārāni sovaṇṇadhajāni hemajālapaṭicchannāni uposathanāgarājapamukhāni || || 22
sn22.96:3.7: Tassa mayham bhikkhu rañño sato khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa caturāsīti assasahassāni ahesuṃ || sovaṇṇālaṅkarāni sovaṇṇadhajāni hemajālāpaṭicchannāni Valāhakaassarājapamukhāni || || 23
sn22.96:3.8: Tassa mayham bhikkhu rañño sato khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa caturāsīti rathasahassāni ahesuṃ || sovaṇṇālaṅkārāni sovaṇṇadhajāni hemajālapaṭicchannāni Vejayantarathapamukhāni || || 24
sn22.96:3.9: Tassa mayham bhikkhu rañño sato khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa caturāsīti maṇisahassāni ahesuṃ maṇiratanapamukhāni || || 25
sn22.96:3.10: Tassa mayham bhikkhu || pa || caturāsīti itthisahassāni ahesuṃ || Subhaddādevīpamukhāni || || 26
sn22.96:3.11: Tassa mayham bhikkhu || pa || caturāsīti khattiyasahassāni ahesuṃ anuyantāni pariṇāyakaratanapamukhāni || || 27
sn22.96:3.12: Tassa mayham bhikkhu || pa || caturāsīti dhenusahassāni ahesuṃ dukulasandanāni kaṃsupadhāraṇani || || 28
sn22.96:3.13: Tassa mayham bhikkhu || pa || caturāsīti vatthakoṭisahassāni ahesuṃ khomasukhumāni koseyyasukhumāni kambalasukhumāni kappāsikasukhumāni || || 29
sn22.96:3.14: Tassa mayham bhikkhu || pa || caturāsīti thālipākasahassāni ahesuṃ || sāyam pātam bhattābhihāro abhiharīyittha || || 30
sn22.96:4.1: Tesaṃ kho pana bhikkhu caturāsītiyā nagarasahassānam ekaññeva taṃ nagaraṃ hoti yam aham tena samayena ajjhāvasāmi Kusāvatī rājadhānī || || 31
sn22.96:4.2: Tesaṃ kho pana bhikkhu caturāsītiyā pāsādasahassānam eko yeva so pāsādo hoti yam aham tena samayena ajjhāvasāmi Dhammo pāsādo || || 32
sn22.96:4.3: Tesaṃ kho pana bhikkhu caturāsītiyā kuṭāgārasahassānam ekaññeva taṃ kūṭāgāraṃ hoti yam ahaṃ tena samayena ajjhāvasāmi Mahābyūhaṃ kūṭāgāraṃ || || 33
sn22.96:4.4: Tesaṃ kho pana bhikkhu caturāsītiyā pallaṅkāsahassānam eko yeva so pallaṅko hoti yam ahaṃ tena samayena paribhuñjāmi dantamayo vā sāramayo vā sovaṇṇa mayo vā rūpiyamayo vā || || 34
sn22.96:4.5: Tesaṃ kho pana bhikkhu caturāsītiyā nāgasahassānam eko yeva so nāgo hoti || yam aham tena samayena abhirūhāmi Uposatho nāgarājā || || 35
sn22.96:4.6: Tesaṃ kho pana bhikkhu caturāsītiyā assasahassānam eko yeva so asso hoti || yam ahaṃ tena samayena abhirūhāmi Valāhaka-assarājā || || 36
sn22.96:4.7: Tesaṃ kho pana bhikkhu caturāsītiyā rathasahassānam eko yeva so ratho hoti || yam ahaṃ tena samayena abhirūhāmi Vejayanto ratho || || 37
sn22.96:4.8: Tesaṃ kho pana bhikkhu caturāsītiyā itthisahassānam ekā yeva sā itthi hoti || yā maṃ tena samayena paccupaṭṭhāti Khattiyāni vā Velamikā vā || || 38
sn22.96:4.9: Tesaṃ kho pana bhikkhu caturāsītiyā vatthakoṭisahassānam ekaññeva taṃ vatthayugam hoti yam ahaṃ tena samayena paridahāmi khomasukhumaṃ vā koseyyasukhumaṃ vā kambalasukhumam vā kappāsikasukhumaṃ vā || || 39
sn22.96:4.10: Tesaṃ kho pana bhikkhu caturāsītiyā thālipākasahassānam eko yeva so thālipāko hoti yato nāḷikodanaparamam bhuñjāmi tadūpiyañca supeyyaṃ || || 40
sn22.96:4.11: Iti kho bhikkhu sabbe te saṅkhārā atītā niruddhā vipariṇātā || || 41
sn22.96:4.15: Yāvañcidam bhikkhu alam eva sabbesu saṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ alaṃ virajjituṃ alaṃ vimuccitun ti || || 1-2 Sāvatthi || || 3
